responsibilities.quote: Ultimately it is the student’s responsibility to ensure that the threshold between minor advice /corrections does not result in the core work including the writing, creativity, arguments, analysis and reasoning no longer being their own.

If the student chooses to use a third party, it is their responsibility to give them a copy of this statement or where a software tool(s) is used, to ensure usage falls within requirements of this statement.
responsibilities.anchor: Principles governing use of third party help
